bestBets.overview: Watch market moves for OCEAN PREDATOR. The patiently handled debutante was good at his most recent trial when stepping up to 1200m at Randwick. 1500m looks ideal for him today. MAREMOTO improved into the placings in a super maiden at Newcastle at her second run back from a break. Out to 1500m looks ideal and winkers go on for the first time. MAGIC MERLIN was runner-up at his first two runs this preparation. He contested a stronger race at Scone last time and finished just behind the placegetters. GOLD EARTH hit the line well at Bathurst when rising to 1400m.
